queries.name: rest.projects_for_tenant
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.get_projects_for_tenant (GET /v1/projects/{tenant})
queries.sql: SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.creator_id, p.name, p.description, p.slug, p.enabled, p.metadata, p.change_report_template_version_id, p.publishable, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, u.name as creator_name, u.email as creator_email, COALESCE(qs.versions_count, 0) AS versions_count, qs.quality_score, CASE WHEN qs.quality_score IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN qs.quality_score >= 90 THEN 'A' WHEN qs.quality_score >= 80 THEN 'B' WHEN qs.quality_score >= 70 THEN 'C' WHEN qs.quality_score >= 60 THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' END AS quality_grade , own.entity_owner FROM apiome.projects p LEFT JOIN apiome.users u ON p.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS versions_count, ROUND(AVG(v.quality_score))::int AS quality_score FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.project_id = p.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ) qs ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'team', jsonb_build_object('id', ot.id::text, 'slug', ot.slug, 'name', ot.name), 'status', eo.status, 'source', eo.source ) AS entity_owner FROM apiome.entity_owners eo JOIN apiome.teams ot ON ot.id = eo.team_id AND ot.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE eo.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND eo.entity_id = p.id AND eo.entity_kind IN ('project', 'catalog_item') ORDER BY (eo.status = 'confirmed') DESC, eo.created_at, eo.id LIMIT 1 ) own ON TRUE WHERE p.tenant_id = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

queries.name: rest.project_by_id
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.get_project_by_id (GET /v1/projects/{tenant}/{project})
queries.sql: SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.creator_id, p.name, p.description, p.slug, p.enabled, p.metadata, p.change_report_template_version_id, p.publishable, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, u.name as creator_name, u.email as creator_email, COALESCE(qs.versions_count, 0) AS versions_count, qs.quality_score, CASE WHEN qs.quality_score IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN qs.quality_score >= 90 THEN 'A' WHEN qs.quality_score >= 80 THEN 'B' WHEN qs.quality_score >= 70 THEN 'C' WHEN qs.quality_score >= 60 THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' END AS quality_grade FROM apiome.projects p LEFT JOIN apiome.users u ON p.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS versions_count, ROUND(AVG(v.quality_score))::int AS quality_score FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.project_id = p.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ) qs ON TRUE WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.tenant_id = $2 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: rest.version_core
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.get_version_core (revision existence / tenancy guards, DBP-1.5 #7188)
queries.sql: SELECT v.id, v.project_id, v.creator_id, v.version_id, v.description, v.visibility, v.published, v.published_at, v.published_immutable, v.mock_enabled, v.enabled, v.parent_version_id, v.merge_parent_version_id, v.forked_from_revision_id, v.upstream_project_id, v.revision_locked, v.commit_author, v.commit_message, v.external_ref, v.source_commit_sha, v.source_committed_at, v.quality_score, v.quality_grade, v.unpublish_reason, v.unpublished_at, v.unpublished_by, v.created_at, v.updated_at, p.tenant_id, p.name AS project_name, p.slug AS project_slug FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id WHERE v.id = $1 AND p.tenant_id = $2 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: rest.versions_for_project
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.get_versions_for_project (GET /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project})
queries.sql: SELECT v.id, v.project_id, v.creator_id, v.version_id, v.description, v.change_log, v.visibility, v.published, v.published_at, v.published_immutable, v.mock_enabled, v.mock_settings, v.enabled, v.parent_version_id, v.merge_parent_version_id, v.forked_from_revision_id, v.upstream_project_id, v.revision_locked, v.metadata, v.commit_author, v.commit_message, v.external_ref, v.source_commit_sha, v.source_committed_at, v.quality_score, v.quality_grade, sec.security_score, sec.security_grade, v.unpublish_reason, v.unpublished_at, v.unpublished_by, vf.version_id AS fork_source_version_string, pf.name AS fork_source_project_name, up.name AS upstream_project_name, v.created_at, v.updated_at, u.name as creator_name, u.email as creator_email, p.name as project_name, p.slug as project_slug FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN apiome.versions vf ON vf.id = v.forked_from_revision_id AND vf.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN apiome.projects pf ON pf.id = vf.project_id AND pf.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN apiome.projects up ON up.id = v.upstream_project_id AND up.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN apiome.users u ON v.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.axes FROM apiome.lint_axis_evaluations e WHERE e.version_record_id = v.id AND e.algorithm_id = 'clx-axis-v1' ORDER BY e.evaluated_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ax ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (sa.axis->>'score')::int AS security_score, sa.axis->>'grade' AS security_grade FROM jsonb_array_elements(ax.axes) AS sa(axis) WHERE sa.axis->>'key' = 'security' AND (sa.axis->>'assessed')::boolean AND sa.axis->>'score' IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 ) sec ON TRUE WHERE v.project_id = $1 AND p.tenant_id = $2 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

queries.name: rest.operation_responses_for_version

queries.sql: SELECT porl.path_operation_id AS loader_path_operation_id, spr.id, spr.status_code, spr.description, spr.data, spr.class_id, c.name as class_name, spr.inline_schema, COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', rc.id, 'media_type', rc.media_type, 'class_id', rc.class_id, 'class_name', rc_class.name, 'inline_schema', rc.inline_schema, 'examples', rc.examples, 'item_schema', rc.item_schema) ORDER BY rc.ctid) FILTER (WHERE rc.id IS NOT NULL), '[]') as content_types FROM apiome.shared_path_response spr INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation_response_link porl ON spr.id = porl.shared_path_response_id INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation po ON po.id = porl.path_operation_id INNER JOIN apiome.version_path vp ON vp.id = po.version_path_id LEFT JOIN apiome.classes c ON spr.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN apiome.shared_path_response_content rc ON spr.id = rc.shared_path_response_id LEFT JOIN apiome.classes rc_class ON rc.class_id = rc_class.id WHERE vp.version_id = $1 GROUP BY porl.path_operation_id, spr.id, spr.status_code, spr.description, spr.data, spr.class_id, c.name, spr.inline_schema ORDER BY porl.path_operation_id, spr.status_code

queries.name: rest.revision_closure
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.fetch_revision_closure (merge preview, revision graph)
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE closure AS ( SELECT v.id, v.parent_version_id, v.merge_parent_version_id, v.created_at, v.version_id FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE v.id::text = ANY($1) AND p.tenant_id = $2 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL UNION SELECT v.id, v.parent_version_id, v.merge_parent_version_id, v.created_at, v.version_id FROM apiome.versions v JOIN closure c ON v.id = c.parent_version_id OR v.id = c.merge_parent_version_id JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE p.tenant_id = $3 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT id::text AS id, parent_version_id::text AS parent_version_id, merge_parent_version_id::text AS merge_parent_version_id, created_at, version_id FROM closure

queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) as total_tenants, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM apiome.tenant_administrators WHERE user_id = $1) as admin_tenants, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM apiome.projects p WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) as total_projects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apiome.projects WHERE creator_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) as created_projects, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND v.deleted_at IS NULL) as total_versions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apiome.versions WHERE creator_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) as created_versions, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND v.published = true AND v.deleted_at IS NULL) as published_versions, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM apiome.classes c JOIN apiome.versions v ON c.version_id = v.id JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.deleted_at IS NULL) as total_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) FROM apiome.properties pr JOIN apiome.projects p ON pr.project_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL) as total_properties, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cp.id) FROM apiome.class_properties cp JOIN apiome.classes c ON cp.class_id = c.id JOIN apiome.versions v ON c.version_id = v.id JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.deleted_at IS NULL) as total_class_properties, (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM (SELECT created_at FROM apiome.projects WHERE creator_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT created_at FROM apiome.versions WHERE creator_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT c.created_at FROM apiome.classes c JOIN apiome.versions v ON c.version_id = v.id WHERE v.creator_id = $1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) activities) as last_activity

queries.name: rest.property_by_digest
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/source_apply_writer.py _resolve_library_properties (source apply: the project property with a given definition, DBP-1.7 #7190)
queries.sql: SELECT p.id FROM apiome.properties p WHERE p.project_id = $1::uuid AND p.data_digest = md5($2::jsonb::text) AND p.data = $2::jsonb ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id LIMIT 1

queries.name: usage.ingest_admission
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/usage_ingest_store.py _admission (every usage ingest batch, under the tenant lock: cap, today's usage_tenant_day counter, newly finalized days; DBP-1.8 #7191)
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.seats -> 'usage_events_per_day') = 'number' THEN (l.seats ->> 'usage_events_per_day')::numeric::bigint ELSE 100000 END FROM apiome.tenants t LEFT JOIN apiome.tenant_licenses tl ON tl.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN apiome.licenses l ON l.id = tl.license_id WHERE t.id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1) AS cap, COALESCE((SELECT d.events_used FROM apiome.usage_tenant_day d WHERE d.tenant_id = $1::uuid AND d.day = date '2026-06-15'), 0) AS used, ARRAY(SELECT r.day FROM apiome.usage_rollup_days r WHERE r.day = ANY (ARRAY[date '2026-06-15']) AND r.finalized_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.day) AS finalized

queries.name: browse.recent_public_versions
queries.source: apiome-browse/lib/db/helper.ts getRecentlyPublishedVersions (browse home 'Recently published' rail; idx_versions_public_published_recent, DBP-1.11 #7194)
queries.sql: SELECT v.id, v.version_id, v.description, v.published_at, v.created_at, p.name AS project_name, p.slug AS project_slug, t.name AS tenant_name, t.slug AS tenant_slug FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id JOIN apiome.tenants t ON p.tenant_id = t.id WHERE v.published = true AND v.visibility = 'public' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, v.created_at DESC LIMIT $1

queries.name: audit.project_timeline
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.list_project_timeline (workflow and protection ledgers of one project; idx_workflow_audit_project_created, idx_version_protection_audit_project_created, DBP-1.11 #7194)
queries.sql: SELECT e.id, e.source, e.action, e.created_at, v.version_id AS version_label FROM ( SELECT wa.id, 'workflow'::text AS source, wa.action, wa.version_id AS revision_id, wa.created_at FROM apiome.workflow_audit wa WHERE wa.tenant_id = $1 AND wa.project_id = $2 UNION ALL SELECT pa.id, 'protection'::text AS source, pa.action, pa.resource_id AS revision_id, pa.created_at FROM apiome.version_protection_audit pa WHERE pa.tenant_id = $1 AND pa.project_id = $2 ) e LEFT JOIN apiome.versions v ON v.id = e.revision_id AND v.project_id = $2 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 50

queries.name: db.version_delete_classes_fk_check
queries.source: PostgreSQL's referential check for classes_version_id_fkey, run once per deleted version (Database.permanently_delete_project; DBP-1.12, #7195: a scan of classes until V418 indexed version_id without the deleted_at predicate)
queries.sql: SELECT 1 FROM ONLY apiome.classes x WHERE $1::uuid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) version_id FOR KEY SHARE OF x
